# GlotChat

> Windows desktop app that runs many WhatsApp and Telegram accounts in one window — each isolated, with its own notifications and proxy — and translates messages, voice notes and photos offline in 49 languages, with a check of every translation before it is sent.

GlotChat is a Windows desktop app. It opens the official WhatsApp Web and Telegram Web for each account in its own isolated session (plus Messenger, Instagram and Discord in beta) and adds offline translation of messages, voice notes and text in photos. Before a reply is sent, it shows the translation translated back into the writer's language and checks that prices, numbers and links are unchanged. It is an independent product, not affiliated with WhatsApp, Meta or Telegram.

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Apps: WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business, Telegram; Messenger, Instagram and Discord in beta
- Accounts: tested with 27 accounts at the same time; each uses about 300–450 MB of memory
- Translation: 49 languages, offline on the user's PC; voice notes recognised in about 100 languages
- Free trial: 3 days, every feature, no payment — starts with one click in the app ("Start my free 3-day trial"), one trial per computer
- Download (Windows installer, version 1.2.5, 381 MB): https://download.glotchat.com/GlotChat-Setup-1.2.5.exe — install guide: https://www.glotchat.com/download/
- Prices (per year, paid in USDT TRC20 · BEP20 · ERC20): Starter 69 USDT (up to 5 accounts, 1 PC), Pro 129 USDT (up to 15 accounts, 1 PC), Business 249 USDT (unlimited accounts, 3 PCs)
- Contact / purchase: Telegram https://t.me/GlotChat
- Website languages: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, العربية, Türkçe, Español, Português, Русский
